text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Signs of fatigue were visible on Yaeno 
Muteki after her Debut race. Caught up in 
the venue's intense heat, keeping her 
fighting spirit in check seemed a 
struggle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next morning, the Trainer spots Yaeno 
Muteki practicing on her own. She 
confesses that after her debut race, she 
felt uncertain about her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer urges her to consult with 
them. She confesses that, being naturally 
bad-tempered and troublesome, she simply 
didn't want to cause any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Trainer assures her that they 
will embrace all her baggage. Looking into 
those sincere eyes, Yaeno Muteki replies 
that she will place her trust in them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two set their sights on the Classic 
Triple Crown route, deciding to enter the 
Mainichi Hai as a prep race.
